newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 2.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* In the U.S. the Dow Jones Industrial Average recovered some ground overnight, after two days of heavy losses to close 27.57 points higher at 6,611.05.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index continued its slide on Tuesday, falling 15.33 points to 1,187.77. Market sentiment was battered by fears of interest rate rises both locally and in the U.S., as well as curbs on lending for property and share financing, announced by Bank Negara on Friday, analysts said.
* In Japan at 0044 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 index trading 5.10 points lower to 17,864.49, after having been around 14 points down earlier in the morning.
* Timber company Aokam reported a net loss of 46 million ringgit for the six months to December 31, 1996. The stock has been among the most active of recent trading sessions.
* Analysts said they expect to see some bargain hunting activity on blue-chip stocks on Wednesday, as they had fallen substantially recently. But trading would remain volatile, they said.
